notes.subject: ol i kapsaitim ol samting bilong sikaut
notes.rationale: חבלו em i 'ol i holim samting bilong man long skaut bilong det' — KJV 'take a pledge'; mi usim pasin bilong sikaut.

notes.subject: pikinini yangpela i no gat papa na mama
notes.rationale: יתום i stap yet — 'yatim', man i lusim ol matua; Tok Pisin i no gat wanpela tok tasol.

translation: Ol i pulim ⟨את⟩ pikinini yangpela i no gat papa na mama i go long susu, na long ol man poro ol i kapsaitim ol samting bilong sikaut.
